definitions.explanation: Land and buildings; immovable property as opposed to movable goods.

{不動産|ふどうさん}{会社|がいしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work at a real estate company.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Literally "non-moving property" — the three characters mean "not" + "move" + "property", i.e. immovable property.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {不動産|ふどうさん} - real estate, immovable property
- ⟦{動産|どうさん}→動産：30308_dousan⟧ - movable property, personal property

- {不動産|ふどうさん}⟦{会社|がいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧ / {不動産|ふどうさん}⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ - real estate company / agent
- {不動産|ふどうさん}⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧ - real estate investment
- {不動産|ふどうさん}⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧ - the real estate industry
- {不動産|ふどうさん}⟦{登記|とうき}→登記：19798_touki⟧ - property registration
- {不動産|ふどうさん}⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧ - real estate transaction
- {不動産|ふどうさん}⟦{鑑定士|かんていし}→鑑定士：22112_kanteishi⟧ - real estate appraiser

APARTMENT HUNTING:
When looking for an apartment in Japan, people typically visit a {不動産|ふどうさん}⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (real estate agent), who shows them available ⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧ (properties).
